lead.headline: Pilots body seeks role in probe review into Air India AI 171 crash
lead.summary:
Pilots body seeks role in probe review into Air India AI 171 crash
The Federation of Indian Pilots has asked the civil aviation ministry to consider its technical submissions before the AI 171 crash report is finalised. The request adds pressure for wider scrutiny and pilot representation at the probe's final stage.

frontpage.headline: IIT Madras, Unicorn India Ventures Mark ==First Close Of Fund I== At ₹450 Cr
frontpage.summary: IIT Madras, IIT Madras Research Park (IITMRP), and Unicorn India Ventures have announced the first close of their deeptech-focused IITM Unicorn Frontier Fund I at ₹450 Cr (about $46.9 Mn). The fund has already deployed nearly ₹55 Cr across four startups — Hathor, Quanastra, Triolt Energy, and Carbelim.

Trump rejects Iran proposal for deal to reopen Hormuz

US President Donald Trump on Saturday rejected a truce deal proposed by Iran that Tehran said could have reopened the Strait of Hormuz to shipping within a week. The waterway is key to the world’s energy supply and is now central to the conflict between the US and Iran, which is at a stalemate after nearly seven months.

stories.headline: India Needs Stronger Infrastructure, Industrial Demand to Scale Green Hydrogen: S&P Global Energy
stories.summary:
India Needs Stronger Infrastructure, Industrial Demand to Scale Green Hydrogen: S&P Global Energy
Updated: Sep 26, 2026 03:06:25pm
New Delhi, Sep 26 (KNN) India’s green hydrogen growth will depend on affordable renewable power, stronger infrastructure and sustained industrial demand, S&P Global Energy said following its Horizons Clean Energy Expansion India 2026 conference. The conference highlighted the need for reliable and cost-competitive renewable power, stronger electricity grids and maritime infrastructure, greater policy certainty and sustained demand from industry.

stories.headline: India’s green hydrogen sector moves towards global cost competitiveness: Pralhad Joshi
stories.summary: India’s green hydrogen sector is moving towards global cost competitiveness, with the lowest discovered bids at Rs 279 per kg for green hydrogen and Rs 49.75 per kg for green ammonia, reported ET Energyworld, citing Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi. Speaking in a video message at S&P Global Energy’s Horizons Clean Energy Expansion India 2026 conference, Joshi said the recently discovered prices indicate that Indian green hydrogen is becoming increasingly competitive with global costs.

stories.headline: Trump administration uses rare authority to claw back nearly ==$1B in spending== approved by Congress
stories.summary:
WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in spending approved by Congress, the White House announced on Friday, using a rare and contested power to axe funding for immigrant services and diversity-focused initiatives. Trump’s Office of Management and Budget described the funding cut as focused on “the most harmful government spending.”
Most of the cuts are focused on Health and Human Services programs that serve refugees and unaccompanied minors accused of being in the country illegally.

stories.headline: Drought declared across ==74% of Indias Maharashtra state==
stories.summary: MUMBAI: Drought has hit 74 percent of Maharashtra, India's richest state and home to the megacity of Mumbai, the state government said on Saturday, after prolonged low rainfall in the region. The declaration came after the national weather department forecast that India would end its annual monsoon season with a rainfall deficit, threatening farmers' livelihoods.

stories.headline: Maharashtra announces drought in 265 of 358 sub-districts | India News
stories.summary:
Maharashtra announces drought in 265 of 358 sub-districts
The state government issued the much-awaited government resolution (GR) on Saturday, announcing a package of 12 measures
As more than 34 of 36 districts reel under an acute water shortage due to deficient rainfall, the Maharashtra government on Saturday declared drought in 265 of the 358 sub-districts, or 74% of the sub-districts, across the state. The prevailing situation in these sub-districts fulfils the Trigger-I (first alert) criteria under the Drought Management Code.

stories.headline: Nepal’s floods expose issues with climate-disaster funding — firmer policies are needed fast
stories.summary: On 26 August, a ‘tsunami’ of water, mud and boulders swept through the Rasuwa region of Nepal, killing more than 1,400 people and leaving about 6,000 more missing. The government estimates that reconstruction will cost almost US$5 billion — roughly 10% of Nepal’s gross domestic product.

stories.headline: Blood test could gauge if a baby has a dangerous infection in 15 minutes
stories.summary: A blood test could determine whether a feverish baby has a bacterial or viral infection in 15 to 20 minutes. This would help doctors gauge whether the infection is serious or may pass without treatment, which could prevent unnecessary use of antibiotics.

stories.headline: Air India AI-171 crash: Pilots' body seeks representation on panel reviewing draft final probe report | India News
stories.summary:
Air India AI-171 crash: Pilots' body seeks representation on panel reviewing draft final probe report
The pilots' body said if an independent mechanism is being created to review the draft probe report in the Ahmedabad plane crash, FIP should be nominated. The Federation of Indian Pilots (FIP) wrote to union civil aviation minister Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu seeking representation in an independent committee which is expected to be constituted to review the draft final investigation report on the Air India AI-171 crash.

stories.headline: CNN barred from Trump’s Air Force One trip to Tennessee despite court order restoring White House access
stories.summary: CNN has been blocked from travelling with President Donald Trump aboard Air Force One for his Saturday trip to Knoxville, Tennessee, just days after a federal judge ordered the administration to restore the network’s White House access. Two people familiar with the matter told The Washington Post that CNN was excluded from the presidential flight.
